message.content: {"output_action": "CREATE", "skill_draft": {"name": "visual_comparison_for_negative_classifier_findings", "description": "When a medical imaging classifier returns negative or empty results for suspected chronic pathology progression, rely on direct visual comparison of morphological changes between timepoints instead of deriving quantitative scores.", "applicable_conditions": "Tasks involving the assessment of temporal progression in chronic conditions where automated classifiers fail to detect subtle or established findings, requiring manual interpretation of serial imaging.", "branch": "task_level", "tool_name": null, "task_category": ["medical_imaging_interpretation"], "required_tools": [], "risk_level": "medium", "core_action": "If the `chest_xray_classifier` (or equivalent imaging tool) returns negative/empty findings despite clinical suspicion of chronic pathology progression: (1) Do not attempt to derive severity scores from the classifier output; (2) Perform a direct side-by-side visual comparison of the current and prior images; (3) Specifically assess morphological changes such as pleural thickening, opacity density, or volume loss to determine progression."}, "patch_target_id": null, "patch_section": null, "patch_content": null}
